text: Post-Fix Pipeline Trace: After fixing a bug, trace the full data flow and verify processing steps execute in correct order — cascading issues are common
Test Assertion Skepticism: When fixing test failures, first verify that test expected values are correct. If the test expectation is wrong, fix the test — not the production code
Contradiction Detection: Before implementing, check if requirements contradict each other. Document contradictions and escalate — don't silently pick one interpretation
Mock Leak Awareness: When tests fail mysteriously, check if test mocks are leaking into production code paths

IT completion rate went from 0% to 100% after embedding ITs directly into todo.md — place action items where agents naturally look
Completion Illusion (KE-180): Analysis gates HARM performance — agents write analysis docs, feel done, skip actual fix. Gate on SOLUTION artifacts, not reports
Hard Gate Design: artifact must be part of the solution, use product-quality metrics, never gate implementation-bottleneck tasks
arXiv is the highest-signal research source — broad query → get IDs → arxiv.org/abs/<id>
